entities.summary: Karl Weyprecht, also spelt Carl Weyprecht, was an Austro-Hungarian explorer. He was an officer in the Austro-Hungarian Navy. He is most famous as an Arctic explorer, and an advocate of international cooperation for scientific polar exploration. Although he did not live to see it occur, he is associated with the organisation of the first International Polar Year. Carl Georg Ludwig Wilhelm Weyprecht was a naval commanders from Bad König (1838-09-08, Bad König–1881-03-29). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to geopolitics.
